timeline.title: Ceasefire, Iran-Saudi talks ease tensions
timeline.line: A Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire and Iran-Saudi talks are helping sentiment, led by autos
more: Auto stocks led sectoral gains early in the session
Banks, IT and FMCG kept the indices lower anyway

src.title: Outlook Money: Sensex, Nifty choppy despite Russia-Ukraine ceasefire, Iran-Saudi talks easing tensions
